title: Adaptive candidate selection and mutation
description: Select, revise or abandon candidates using observed feedback and coverage of distinct hypotheses. Search strategy determines which candidate to try; it is separate from the mechanism and injection surface.
when_to_try: Choosing the next experiment after a reply or comparing alternative candidates.
prerequisites: Explicit trial budgets, feedback access and records of previous attempts.
limitations: AgentVigil uses benchmark-derived success feedback; the current attacker receives public chat replies only.
Best-of-N and corpus-level results are not one-candidate success probabilities.
This record does not add MCTS, branching, replay or extra target calls to the controller.

sources.note: AgentVigil combines a seed corpus, semantic mutation, scoring and tree search for indirect prompt injection.
